evals.prompt: Set Periplus up in this project and make a map. It is a Laravel application.
evals.expected_output: Periplus is initialised, init pins laravel_basic from composer.json and php_basic loads with it, the map is built once, and the answer says what was mapped and which files no rule read.
expectations: Runs periplus --version first and does not install the tool without asking
Runs periplus init and periplus status before it edits the settings
Keeps the laravel_basic pin init wrote and pins no Laravel rutter by hand
Runs periplus map once and reports the counts from periplus types and the files no rule read

evals.prompt: Which rutters does this project need? It has a pyproject.toml and Python code, and no .periplus folder.
evals.expected_output: The answer says that no bundled rutter reads Python, pins nothing for it, and points to the example rutter and the periplus-rutter skill.
expectations: Says plainly that no bundled rutter covers Python
Does not pin a bundled rutter the project gives no evidence for
Names the example rutters or the periplus-rutter skill as the way to map Python
